Container.Name: mcp-trilium-connector
Container.Overview: MCP connector for TriliumNext (ETAPI): search, read and write notes, links, labels and relations. Read-only by default.

Config.Name: TRILIUM_URL
Config.Description: Address of TriliumNext as seen from the mcp_network

Config.Name: TRILIUM_TOKEN_FILE
Config.Description: Path inside the container to the ETAPI token (leave as is)

Config.Name: MCP_BEARER_TOKEN_FILE
Config.Description: Path inside the container to the bearer token that Claude uses (leave as is)

Config.Name: TRILIUM_ENABLE_WRITE
Config.Description: true: create, edit, move notes, labels, relations

Config.Name: TRILIUM_ENABLE_DESTRUCTIVE
Config.Description: true: also delete_note (needs write; soft delete)

Config.Name: Bearer token file
Config.Description: Host file with the bearer token for Claude

Config.Name: ETAPI token file
Config.Description: Host file with the ETAPI token (Trilium: Options > ETAPI)
